description: Audits any cold email, LinkedIn message, or outreach sequence against a strict quality checklist and rewrites every failing element. Use when asked "refine this email", "clean up my copy", "check this email", "can you review this sequence", "fix my cold email", or whenever outreach copy is shared and needs to be tightened up. Also use when the user pastes an email and asks if it's good, too long, too formal, or "too salesy". Always produces a pass/fail audit + a corrected version of the copy.
